evidence.AC1: POST /todos with {"title":"past","dueDate":"2020-01-01"} returned 201 with dueDate "2020-01-01", a date only with no time. POST without dueDate returned 201 with dueDate null, so the field is optional.
evidence.AC2: PATCH /todos/2 {"dueDate":"2020-02-02"} returned 200 and the new date. PATCH {"dueDate":null} returned 200 with dueDate null, so the date was removed. PATCH /todos/4 {"dueDate":"2021-05-05"} added a date to a todo that had none. PATCH {"title":"past2"} left the date unchanged.
evidence.AC3: POST with dueDate "2026-02-30", "13.11.2026" and "2026-11-13T10:00:00" each returned 400. PATCH with "2026-02-30" and "garbage" each returned 400.
evidence.AC4: Today is 2026-11-13 (UTC). GET /todos?overdue=true returned only the todo due 2020-01-01. Excluded from it: the todo due today (2026-11-13), the todo with no due date, and the done todo with due date 2021-05-05 (overdue:false once done). GET /todos?overdue=false returned the non-overdue todos.
evidence.AC5: The list page at / showed "fällig 01.01.2020", "fällig 13.11.2026" and "fällig 05.05.2021" next to the todos that have due dates. The todo without a due date showed none.
evidence.AC6: On the list page only the not-done todo due 2020-01-01 showed the word "überfällig". The todos due today, with no date, and done with a past date showed no marker.
evidence.AC7: The page has a checkbox labelled "nur überfällige". Clicking it reduced the list to the single overdue todo (past2).
